Du har ikke funnet helordet ennå. Det vi: You haven't found the whole word yet. It's shown when the round is over.
Sjongløren kaster seks eller sju bokstav: The juggler throws six or seven letters into the air. Make as many words as you can from them – and find the whole word that uses them all.
Trykk på bokstavene, eller skriv på tast: Tap the letters, or type on a keyboard, and press «Enter». A word needs at least three letters, and each letter can be used only as many times as it is in the air.
Tre bokstaver gir 1 poeng, fire gir 2, f: Three letters score 1 point, four score 2, five score 3, six score 4 and seven score 5. The whole word scores 10 extra.
Seks bokstaver i de to første rundene, s: Six letters in the first two rounds, seven in the last three. Against the clock each round has two minutes; with no clock you move on when you like.
Bøyde former teller også, som flertall o: Other forms count too, such as plurals and past tenses.
Kast bokstavene opp igjen for å se dem i: Throw the letters up again to see them in a new order – it often gives you new ideas.
Raden over bokstavene viser hvor mange o: The row above the letters shows how many words there are of each length. The star is the whole word.
Når runden er over, ser du alle ordene d: When the round is over, you see every word you could have found.
Ordlista bygger på Norsk ordbank – bokmå: The word list comes from ENABLE (public domain), kept to the common words of 12dicts by Alan Beale (public domain) and British spelling. Rude, crude and very rare words are left out.
Letters in the air. Words in your hand.
Finner du helordet?: Can you find the whole word?
Takk for runden – neste gang lander fler: Thanks for playing – more words will land next time.
Du ser poengene så langt. Spillet teller: You'll see your points so far. A game only counts for your record when all five rounds are played.
